title: Flood, Ukraine, 26 June 2020 (FL20200626UKR)
description:
UNOSAT geodata for Flood, Ukraine, 26 June 2020 (FL20200626UKR), from 1 dataset on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. HDX describes the event:

**UNOSAT code: FL20200626UKR**  This map illustrates satellite-detected surface waters in Ivano-Frankivska  and Ternopilska Oblastof Ukraine as observed from a  Sentinel-1 image acquired on 24 June 2020. Within the ana lyzed area  of about 642 km2, a  total of a bout 35 km2 of lands appear to be flooded.
This is a  preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to UNITAR-UNOSAT .

HDX datasets:

- [Satellite detected waters in Ivano-Frankivska and Ternopilska Oblast of Ukraine as of 24 June 2020](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/waters-in-ivano-frankivska-and-ternopilska-oblast-of-ukraine-as-of-24-june-2020)
